visual.prompt: Whimsical children's book cover illustration titled Gara-Gara Kucing, a cute chubby orange tabby cat with white paws resting on a lush leafy mango tree branch, looking down mischievously, tropical Indonesian village house in background, signature folk art gouache style of Priya Kuriyan, textured brushstrokes, warm golden hour lighting --no text, no watermark, no typography

audio.text: Gara-Gara Kucing! Karya Anushka Ravishankar dan Priya Kuriyan.
audio.foleyCue: Soft fairytale harp chime, gentle morning birds

en.text: It's All the Cat's Fault! Written by Anushka Ravishankar, Illustrated by Priya Kuriyan.

visual.prompt: A cheerful 8-year-old Indonesian schoolboy in a red striped t-shirt making a funny dramatic excuse with open palms to his teacher in a colorful classroom, empty notebook on desk, folk art gouache storybook illustration by Priya Kuriyan, lively character expressions, textured brushwork --no text, no watermark, no typography

audio.text: Mengapa kamu tidak mengerjakan tugas? Bu, ini semua gara-gara kucing!
audio.foleyCue: Chalk on blackboard, book page rustling, boy earnest voice

en.text: Why haven't you done your homework? Ma'am, it's all the cat's fault!

visual.prompt: A chubby round ginger tabby cat with white paws stuck high up in a large leafy mango tree meowing, an 8-year-old Indonesian boy in a red striped shirt dragging an old wooden bamboo ladder across the green lawn to help it, folk art gouache style, rich green foliage, sunny morning --no text, no watermark, no typography

audio.text: Kalau kucing itu tidak terjebak di atas pohon, saya tidak akan mengambil tangga untuk membantunya.
audio.foleyCue: Cat meow squeak, wooden ladder dragging on grass

en.text: If the cat hadn't climbed up the tree, I wouldn't have gone to fetch the ladder.

visual.prompt: An Indonesian boy tapping a wooden ladder with a small mallet in a tropical garden; in the background through an open house window, a cute baby in a colorful batik cloth hanging cradle wakes up crying with tear drops, folk art gouache children's book illustration --no text, no watermark, no typography

audio.text: Kalau tidak menaiki tangga itu, saya tidak akan tahu tangga perlu diperbaiki. Kalau tidak memperbaiki tangga, saya tidak akan membangunkan adik bayi.
audio.foleyCue: Hammer tapping wood tok-tok, baby crying loudly waaa

en.text: If I hadn't climbed the ladder, I wouldn't have known it was broken. If I hadn't mended the ladder, I wouldn't have woken the baby.

visual.prompt: An Indonesian mother rushing hurriedly out of a rustic kitchen with fluttering yellow batik daster; in the background, a cheeky wild brown monkey leaps in through the open kitchen window toward the food table, humorous folk art gouache storybook illustration --no text, no watermark, no typography

audio.text: Kalau adik bayi tidak terbangun, ibu saya tidak akan terburu-buru meninggalkan dapur. Kalau ibu tidak meninggalkan dapur, monyet tidak akan masuk.
audio.foleyCue: Hurried footsteps on floor, open window squeak, cheeky monkey chatter

en.text: If the baby hadn't woken up, my mother wouldn't have run out of the kitchen. If mother hadn't left the kitchen, the monkey wouldn't have got in.

visual.prompt: A messy kitchen with empty pots and a happy cheeky monkey licking its paws; outside on a sunny village lane, an Indonesian father pedaling a vintage bicycle carrying paper-wrapped packages of bread and steaming chicken curry from the market, folk art gouache illustration --no text, no watermark, no typography

audio.text: Kalau monyet tidak masuk, ia tidak akan menghabiskan semua makanan. Kalau makanan tidak habis dimakan monyet, bapak tidak akan membeli roti dan kari ayam di pasar.
audio.foleyCue: Clay pots clinking, sizzling aroma whoosh, bicycle bell ting-ting

en.text: If the monkey hadn't got in, it wouldn't have eaten all the food. If it hadn't eaten all the food, my father wouldn't have gone to buy bread and chicken curry.

visual.prompt: A charming scruffy brown dog with floppy ears happily trotting behind a bicycle on a dusty tropical village road, sniffing the tantalizing aroma of warm bread and curry wrapped in paper, vibrant folk art gouache illustration, warm afternoon sun --no text, no watermark, no typography

audio.text: Kalau bapak tidak membeli roti di pasar, anjing itu tidak akan mengikuti bapak ke rumah.
audio.foleyCue: Dog sniffing sniff-sniff, paws pattering on dirt road, tail wagging

en.text: If father hadn't bought bread and curry, the dog wouldn't have followed him home.

visual.prompt: Underneath a wooden dining table, the scruffy brown dog is enthusiastically chewing, tearing, and shredding a schoolboy's lined paper homework notebook into confetti scraps; an 8-year-old Indonesian boy peers under the table in complete horror with hands on cheeks, humorous folk art gouache illustration --no text, no watermark, no typography

audio.text: Kalau anjing itu tidak mengikuti bapak ke rumah, ia tidak akan memakan tugas sekolah saya.
audio.foleyCue: Paper ripping and crinkling, dog chomping sounds, boy gasp

en.text: If the dog hadn't followed him home, it wouldn't have eaten my homework!

visual.prompt: Close-up portrait of the Indonesian mother or teacher standing with arms crossed, head tilted with one eyebrow raised in amused disbelief and a warm comedic smile looking down, folk art gouache storybook illustration by Priya Kuriyan, expressive character portrait --no text, no watermark, no typography

audio.text: Oalah, jadi tugas sekolahmu dimakan anjing?
audio.foleyCue: Quiet room ambiance, wall clock ticking tik-tok, amused chuckle

en.text: So your homework was eaten by a dog?!

visual.prompt: The cheerful 8-year-old Indonesian boy nodding vigorously with a triumphant wide smile and open arms, while in the sunny background on the veranda windowsill, the chubby orange tabby cat sits peacefully grooming its paw, totally unbothered, heartwarming comedic folk art gouache finale --no text, no watermark, no typography

audio.text: Iya, Bu. Itu semua gara-gara kucing!
audio.foleyCue: Cat purring vibration, triumphant boy voice, cheerful closing chime

en.text: Yes, ma'am! It was all the cat's fault!
